The FOMC statement signals a moderately positive macro backdrop—low unemployment, strong job gains, and inflation near the symmetric 2 percent objective—supporting gradual policy normalization. Incorporating the Financial Stability Report perspective tempers this optimism: the FSR around this period highlighted elevated asset valuations and rising risk-taking in segments such as leveraged loans, even as core banking resilience and funding risks remained solid. That mix—firm cyclical conditions but building medium-term vulnerabilities—keeps risks broadly balanced yet warrants a touch more caution than the statement alone implies. Net effect: slightly positive tone with a modest downgrade for financial-stability considerations.
